full.thumbnail_title: IS THIS REMOTE JOB A SCAM?

scenes.title: The job that is in a hurry.
scenes.body: A real remote job can wait one extra day. A fake one shouts because delay kills the sale.
scenes.voice: A real remote job can wait one extra day. A fake one cannot, which is why it shouts. This is a checklist, not a crime drama.

scenes.title: They pay you to pay them.
scenes.body: Equipment fees • training fees • software licenses • 'starter kits'
scenes.voice: Flag one. They pay you to pay them. Equipment fees, training fees, software licenses. A job that starts with your debit card is not onboarding.

scenes.title: The company has no body.
scenes.body: No working website • no real address • no named humans • logo in a Google Doc
scenes.voice: Flag two. The company has no body. No real address, no working site, no named humans. A logo in a Google Doc is clip art with ambition.

scenes.title: The interview never happens.
scenes.body: A text. A form. An offer in twelve minutes.
scenes.voice: Flag three. There is no interview. Just a text, a form, and an offer in twelve minutes. Hiring is annoying. Scammers skip the annoying part.

scenes.title: The check arrives first.
scenes.body: Buy gear. Wire the rest back. The check can bounce after the cash is gone.
scenes.voice: Flag four. A check arrives first. Then they ask you to buy gear and wire the rest back. That check can bounce after you sent the cash.

scenes.title: Two minutes. Type it yourself.
scenes.body: Search the exact company name. Open the official careers page. Do not tap the texted link.
scenes.voice: Two-minute check. Search the exact company name plus the word careers. Open the official site yourself. Do not use the link they texted.

scenes.title: Use official channels.
scenes.body: Complain through official government or bank channels. Do not pay a recovery expert who DMs you.
scenes.voice: If you already sent money, use official complaint channels. Do not pay a recovery expert who direct messages you.

scenes.title: Save the card. Close the tab.
scenes.body: A real employer will survive a slow Tuesday. Keep your selfie and your routing number.
scenes.voice: A real employer will survive a slow Tuesday. Save the card. Close the tab. Keep your selfie.

short.thumbnail_subtitle: If they pay you to pay them

scenes.title: If they pay you to pay them, it is not a job.
scenes.body: No equipment fee. No starter check. No mystery Gmail employer.
scenes.voice: If they pay you to pay them, it is not a job. No equipment fee. No training fee. No starter check.

scenes.title: No body, no interview, no tap.
scenes.body: Logo-only companies and twelve-minute offers fail the sniff test.
scenes.voice: No company with only a logo and a Gmail address. No offer before a real conversation.

scenes.title: Type the name yourself.
scenes.body: Open the official careers page. Do not tap their link.
scenes.voice: Type the company name yourself. Do not tap their link.

scenes.title: A real job can wait one day.
scenes.body: Save the checklist. Close the tab.
scenes.voice: A real job can wait one day. Save the checklist.
